name: ac-combat-shields-direct-hit
description: Live pbd161 regression: space combat at 308 (pbd60 save 122). Muaat plays Shields Holding and every other seat holds a Sabotage, so all three must pass in the engine window (action_card.sabotage pass). Then mentak plays Direct Hit and muaat, ghost and crimson pass. The original code has no Direct Hit target step (playAC posts only a reminder text), so the scenario ends at the window. Each pass must land on Direct Hit's own window: Shields Holding's finished window keeps its buttons and is re-captured with a newer seq after Direct Hit is played, so the harness now prefers windows the seat has not answered (the 10:19 failure 'You already responded to this window' was that, not fork drift; it reproduced on a fresh fork). audit-gaps-2 (TI4_RULES_AC): Direct Hit needs another player's damaged ship in the active system (a SUSTAIN DAMAGE was used) and Experimental Battlestation a space dock of yours in or adjacent to it — the setup adds a damaged muaat dreadnought.
